newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.05 down at 40.40 to the dollar on Sunday in the kerb market amid a return of demand for the dollar, dealers said.
They said the dollar, which had been falling for the past few days, had achieved attractive levels and might push the rupee further down on Monday.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 rupees to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at unchanged at 9.0 percent.
